text:
For a Caribbean or Latin American conversion, a practical soft-brand shortlist usually includes the following:

### Most frequently shortlisted global collections

| Parent company | Collection brands | Typical conversion fit |
|---|---|---|
| **Marriott International** | **The Luxury Collection**, **Autograph Collection**, **Tribute Portfolio** | Luxury resorts and historic hotels; upper-upscale lifestyle properties; upscale boutiques, respectively. Marriott specifically positions these collections for independent hotels seeking access to Marriott Bonvoy while retaining individuality. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands/premium-brands?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hilton** | **Curio Collection by Hilton**, **Tapestry Collection by Hilton**; selectively **LXR Hotels & Resorts** | Curio is especially relevant for upper-upscale resorts and distinctive full-service hotels; Tapestry generally fits smaller upscale conversions. Both have active conversion growth in CALA, including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, the Dominican Republic, Argentina and Suriname. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/hiltons-curio-and-tapestry-collections-celebrate-200th-hotel-milestones?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hyatt** | **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt**, **JdV by Hyatt**, **Destination by Hyatt** | Unbound for luxury or story-rich resorts; JdV for lifestyle boutiques; Destination for larger destination resorts and residences. JdV entered the Caribbean in Punta Cana in 2025, while Unbound added a Dominican Republic resort in 2026. ([newsroom.hyatt.com](https://newsroom.hyatt.com/news-releases?item=124064&utm_source=openai)) |
| **IHG** | **Vignette Collection** | High-quality luxury and lifestyle conversions retaining their existing name, design and identity. Its first South American property opened in Lima in March 2025. ([development.ihg.com](https://development.ihg.com/hotel-brands/vignette-collection?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Accor** | **Emblems Collection**, **MGallery**, **Handwritten Collection** | Luxury, upper-upscale and midscale/upscale independents, respectively. Accor positions these collection brands as conversion vehicles that preserve property identity. ([group.accor.com](https://group.accor.com/en/news-stories/collection-brands-handwritten-emblems-mgallery?utm_source=openai)) |

### Other credible conversion platforms

- **Wyndham:** **Registry Collection Hotels** for luxury resorts and **Trademark Collection by Wyndham** for a broader range of independent upscale properties. Trademark has meaningful regional activity, including all-inclusive affiliations and properties in Mexico, Belize, Curaçao and Sint Maarten. ([development.wyndhamhotels.com](https://development.wyndhamhotels.com/convert-your-existing-hotel?utm_source=openai))
- **Choice Hotels:** **Ascend Collection** for upscale boutique, historic and resort conversions; **Radisson Individuals** for upper-upscale hotels. Ascend has an established presence in Mexico, Ecuador, Chile and throughout the Caribbean. ([choicehotelsdevelopment.com](https://www.choicehotelsdevelopment.com/news/choice-hotels-relaunches-radisson-individuals-as-part-of-its-portfolio-of-brands-MCGUOTHASSNZBF5OUH7E7UATMTII?utm_source=openai))
- **BWH Hotels:** **BW Signature Collection**, **BW Premier Collection**, and the **WorldHotels** collections—Luxury, Elite, Crafted, Distinctive and Backdrop. These can be attractive when the owner prioritizes relatively high operating and design independence. ([development.bwhhotels.com](https://development.bwhhotels.com/bwpremier?utm_source=openai))
- **Hyatt’s Unscripted by Hyatt:** a newer upscale, conversion-oriented collection brand. It may enter future discussions, although it has less regional operating history than Hyatt’s established independent collections. ([newsroom.hyatt.com](https://newsroom.hyatt.com/may-30-2025-unscriptedbyhyatt?utm_source=openai))

### Lighter-touch alternatives to a conventional soft-brand franchise

Owners wanting to remain more fully independent may also evaluate:

- **Preferred Hotels & Resorts**
- **The Leading Hotels of the World**
- **Small Luxury Hotels of the World**
- **Design Hotels**, which can provide access to Marriott Bonvoy for participating properties

These are generally membership, representation or distribution affiliations rather than conventional hotel franchises, so they may preserve more identity and operating freedom—but typically provide less brand enforcement, technical support and lender recognition than a major-chain collection. ([join.preferredhotels.com](https://join.preferredhotels.com/?utm_source=openai))

### Typical shortlist by asset

- **Luxury Caribbean resort:** Luxury Collection, Autograph, Curio, Unbound, Vignette, Registry, Emblems/MGallery.
- **Upscale independent resort:** Tribute, Tapestry, JdV, Trademark, Ascend, BW Premier Collection.
- **Urban lifestyle conversion:** Autograph, Tribute, Curio, Tapestry, JdV, Handwritten, Radisson Individuals.
- **Owner seeking maximum independence:** Preferred, LHW, SLH, Design Hotels or WorldHotels.

“Soft” does not mean standards-free. The decisive comparison should include required PIP, all-inclusive capability, franchise versus management availability, loyalty contribution, distribution strength in the property’s feeder markets, fees, key money, territorial protections, residential compatibility and termination rights. Availability can also differ materially by country because of master-franchise and development-right arrangements.
